calls.title: Ashley Stirrup and Ton Wesseling
calls.summary: The team discussed a strategic shift to optimize event locations, expanding West Coast events to improve attendance by reducing long travel times from Europe. Monthly events will be held in nine locations, including San Diego due to favorable weather. GrowthBook reported significant growth, with plans to double revenue supported by key customers like Salesforce and Wikipedia, driven by continuous innovation. The Experimentation Culture Awards have evolved into a global platform celebrating long-term experimentation maturity. Sponsorship of these awards offers credibility and engagement opportunities, while a new AI Award category aims to integrate AI into experimentation processes. The application process for the awards opens next week, emphasizing confidentiality and support for applicants.
calls.keywords: Experimentation Culture Awards, AI Award, GrowthBook, Sponsorship, Application Process, International Expansion
calls.action_items:
**Ashley Stirrup**
Sign up GrowthBook for sponsorship and the new AI Award category to highlight innovative AI integration in experimentation (11:47)
Promote the Experimentation Culture Awards extensively within GrowthBook’s 3,000-user community via Slack, LinkedIn, and direct outreach to enterprise customers (20:41)
Assist GrowthBook customers with award application preparation to improve submission quality and generate case study leads (18:38)
Establish LinkedIn connection with Ton Wesseling to facilitate smoother collaboration and social media tagging (26:34)
Share detailed marketing and promotional content about the Experimentation Culture Awards with Ton Wesseling for outreach purposes (27:23)

**Ton Wesseling**
Send Ashley login access, recordings of prior Experimentation Culture Awards editions, and official sponsorship contract and documentation including application preparation guides (05:39)
Embed GrowthBook branding on the awards website before the application opening to enhance sponsor visibility (23:24)
Share blog posts and social media content about last year’s winners and award learnings with Ashley to support promotional efforts (25:28)
Follow up via email with Ashley to finalize sponsorship, provide all final materials, and detailed guidance on preparing award submissions (28:51)
Accept LinkedIn connection request from Ashley and share social media handles for tagging and collaboration purposes (26:48)
